featured_title: How to Protect Your Closing Funds From Wire Fraud in Southwest Florida FL: 2026 Buyer's Guide
featured_excerpt: Verify wire instructions by calling your title company at a number you looked up yourself, and agree on a spoken code word with your closing team before the first dollar moves. Florida ranks third in the nation for cybercrime losses — and if a wire already went out, you have roughly 72 hours to act.
